sqlStatement:
SELECT 
    A.ITEMID,
    SUM(A.PHYSICALINVENT) AS PHYSICALINVENTORY,
    SUM(A.AVAILPHYSICAL)  AS AVAILABLEPHYSICAL,
    SUM(A.RESERVPHYSICAL) AS RESERVPHYSICAL,
    SUM(A.[ONORDER]) AS [ONORDER (Outbound)]
FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTSUM_V] A
JOIN [INVENTDIM_V] B
  ON A.INVENTDIMID = B.INVENTDIMID
 AND A.DATAAREAID  = B.DATAAREAID
LEFT JOIN [INVENTBATCH_V] C
  ON A.ITEMID        = C.ITEMID
 AND A.DATAAREAID    = C.DATAAREAID
 AND B.INVENTBATCHID = C.INVENTBATCHID
 AND B.[PARTITION]   = C.[PARTITION]
WHERE A.DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
  AND B.INVENTLOCATIONID IN ('BT', 'BT-OPS', 'BT-DIST')
  AND (B.WMSLOCATIONID IS NULL OR B.WMSLOCATIONID NOT IN ('PS-MRB', 'PS-QUAR', 'PS-RAF', 'PS-4C-RAF', 'PS-20-RAF', 'PS-80-RAF'))
  AND (C.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE IS NULL OR C.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY A.ITEMID;
description: Aggregates inventory quantities by item from on-hand inventory view, filtered by location and best-before date.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    INVENTLOCATIONID,
    ITEMID,
    CREATEDDATETIME,
    REMAININVENTPHYSICAL,
    SALESID,
    DW_Id,
    DATAAREAID,
    SALESQTY,
    REMAINSALESPHYSICAL,
    REMAINSALESFINANCIAL,
    [Outstanding Quantity],
    [Unit Cost],
    [SALESSTATUS]
FROM dbo.SALESLINE_V
WHERE
    DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
    AND CREATEDDATETIME >= '2025-08-08'
description: Extracts sales line details for company 'rdsi' since August 8, 2025.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    ITEMID,
    NAME,
    CASE CAST(PRODSTATUS AS varchar(10))
        WHEN '0' THEN 'Created'
        WHEN '1' THEN 'Estimated'
        WHEN '2' THEN 'Scheduled'
        WHEN '3' THEN 'Released'
        WHEN '4' THEN 'Started'
        WHEN '5' THEN 'Reported as Finished'
        WHEN '7' THEN 'Ended'
        ELSE CAST(PRODSTATUS AS varchar(10))
    END AS PRODSTATUS,
    PRODTYPE,
    SCHEDSTATUS,
    QTYSCHED,
    QTYSTUP,
    QTYCALC,
    RESERVATION,
    PRODPOSTINGTYPE,
    INVENTTRANSID,
    INVENTREFTYPE,
    INVENTREFID,
    INVENTREFTRANSID,
    REMAININVENTPHYSICAL,
    BOMID,
    PRODID,
    INVENTDIMID
FROM dbo.ProdTable_V
WHERE
    DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
    AND PRODSTATUS NOT IN (5, 7)
description: Retrieves active production orders with human-readable status values, excluding finished and ended orders.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    ItemCode,
    WarehouseCode,
    TransactionDate,
    TransactionCode,
    TransactionQty
FROM IM_ItemTransactionHistory
WHERE
    TransactionDate >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETDATE())
    AND TransactionCode = 'SO'
    AND TransactionQty < 0
    AND CustomerNo <> '0035509'
description: Extracts sales order transactions from last 6 months, excluding transactions from customer 0035509.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    it.[Item ID],
    it.[Date Physical],
    it.[Outbound Quantity],
    it.[Cost Amount],
    it.[Transaction Type],
    ijt.UnitCost AS [Journal Unit Cost]
FROM [dbo].[Inventory Transactions_V] it
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Inventory Trans Origin_V] ito
    ON  it.INVENTTRANSORIGIN = ito.[RECID]
    AND it.Company = ito.DATAAREAID
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Inventory Journal Document_V] ijd
    ON  ito.[REFERENCEID] = ijd.[Journal ID]
    AND ito.DATAAREAID = ijd.Company
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        Company,
        [Item ID],
        MIN([Unit Cost]) AS UnitCost
    FROM [dbo].[Inventory Journal Transactions_V]  
    WHERE
        [Unit Cost] <> 0
        AND Company = 'rdsi'
    GROUP BY
        Company,
        [Item ID]
) ijt
    ON  ijt.Company = it.Company
    AND ijt.[Item ID] = it.[Item ID]
WHERE
    it.[Company] = 'rdsi'
    AND it.[Transaction Type] IN (0, 8)
    AND it.[Date Physical] >= '2025-08-01'
    AND it.[Item ID] IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT [Item ID]
        FROM [dbo].[Item_V]
        WHERE PHANTOM = 0
    )
    AND (
        ijd.[Journal Name Description] IS NULL
        OR ijd.[Journal Name Description] NOT IN (
            'Obsolete (AX) - Finished Goods',
            'Obsolete (AX) - Intermediates',
            'Obsolete (AX) - Raw Materials',
            'Scrapped Inventory (AX) - Raw Materials',
            'Scrapped Inventory (AX) Shipping Packaging',
            'Scrapped Inventory (AX)-Finished Goods',
            'Scrapped Inventory (AX)-Intermediates'
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    it.[Date Physical] DESC;
description: Complex join retrieving inventory transactions with unit costs, excluding obsolete and scrap transactions since August 1, 2025.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
      BV.[BOMID]                                    AS [Parent Number],
      BV.[ITEMID]                                   AS [Line Part],
      BV.[BOMQTY]                                   AS [BOM Lines Qty],
      BV.[OPRNUM]                                   AS [Oper. Num.],
      BV.[UNITID]                                   AS [UOM],
      BV.[ITEMBOMID],
      BV.[DATAAREAID],
      BVV.[NAME],
      BVV.[FROMDATE],
      BVV.[FROMQTY],
      BVV.[RECID],
      BT.[ITEMGROUPID],
      H.[PERSONNELNUMBER]                           AS [APPROVER],
      BT.[SITEID]                                   AS [Site],
      CASE WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 0 THEN 'No'
           WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      END                                           AS [APPROVED],
      IV.[Item Name]                                AS [Product Name],
      H.[Employee Name]                             AS [Approver Name],
      CASE WHEN BV.[BOMQTYSERIE] = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE BV.[BOMQTY] * 1.0 / BV.[BOMQTYSERIE]
      END                                           AS [Conversion Factor],
      CONCAT(BV.[BOMID], ' / ', BV.[ITEMID])         AS [Parent-Child]
FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV
LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOM_V] BV
       ON BV.[ITEMID] = IV.[Item ID]
      AND BV.[DATAAREAID] = IV.[Company]
LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOMVERSION_V] BVV
       ON BVV.[BOMID] = BV.[BOMID]
      AND BVV.[DATAAREAID] = BV.[DATAAREAID]
LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOMTABLE_V] BT
       ON BT.[BOMID] = BV.[BOMID]
      AND BT.[DATAAREAID] = BV.[DATAAREAID]
LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[HCMWORKER_V] H
       ON H.[RECID] = BT.[APPROVER]
WHERE IV.[Company] = 'rdsi'
  AND BV.[ITEMID] <> 'NULL'
  AND BVV.[ACTIVE] = 1
ORDER BY BV.[BOMID];
description: Joins BOM structure with item, version, approval, and worker information for active BOMs, including conversion factors.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    PB.PRODID,
    PB.DATAAREAID,
    PB.PARTITION,
    CAST(PB.ITEMID AS varchar(80)) AS [Line Part],
    CAST(PB.BOMID  AS varchar(80)) AS [Parent Number],
    PB.BOMQTY,
    PB.QTYBOMCALC,
    CAST(PB.INVENTTRANSID AS varchar(80)) AS INVENTTRANSID,
    CAST(IT.INVENTDIMID AS varchar(80)) AS INVENTDIMID,
    CAST(D.INVENTBATCHID AS varchar(80)) AS INVENTBATCHID,
    B.EXPDATE,
    B.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE
FROM dbo.ProdBom_V PB
LEFT JOIN dbo.[Inventory Trans Origin_V] O
  ON O.INVENTTRANSID = PB.INVENTTRANSID
 AND O.DATAAREAID    = PB.DATAAREAID
 AND O.ITEMID        = PB.ITEMID
 AND O.REFERENCEID   = PB.PRODID
LEFT JOIN dbo.[Inventory Transactions_V] IT
  ON IT.INVENTTRANSORIGIN = O.RECID
 AND IT.Company           = PB.DATAAREAID
 AND IT.[Item ID]         = PB.ITEMID
LEFT JOIN dbo.INVENTDIM_V D
  ON D.INVENTDIMID = IT.INVENTDIMID
 AND D.DATAAREAID  = PB.DATAAREAID
 AND D.PARTITION   = PB.PARTITION
LEFT JOIN dbo.INVENTBATCH_V B
  ON B.ITEMID        = PB.ITEMID
 AND B.INVENTBATCHID = D.INVENTBATCHID
 AND B.DATAAREAID    = PB.DATAAREAID
 AND B.PARTITION     = PB.PARTITION
WHERE PB.DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
description: Links production BOM components to batch/expiry information for visibility of best-before-date across the BOM.

sqlStatement:
WITH Inv_location AS (
    SELECT
        S.ITEMID,
        D.INVENTLOCATIONID,
        D.WMSLOCATIONID,
        D.INVENTBATCHID,
        SUM(S.PHYSICALINVENT)  AS PHYSICALINVENTORY,
        SUM(S.AVAILPHYSICAL)   AS AVAILABLEPHYSICAL,
        SUM(S.RESERVPHYSICAL)  AS RESERVPHYSICAL,
        SUM(S.ONORDER)         AS ONORDER,
        SUM(S.ORDERED)         AS ORDERED,
        B.EXPDATE,
        B.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE,
        E.[Item Name]
    FROM dbo.INVENTSUM_V S
    JOIN dbo.INVENTDIM_V D
      ON S.INVENTDIMID = D.INVENTDIMID
     AND S.DATAAREAID  = D.DATAAREAID
     AND S.[PARTITION] = D.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN dbo.INVENTBATCH_V B
      ON B.ITEMID        = S.ITEMID
     AND B.INVENTBATCHID = D.INVENTBATCHID
     AND B.DATAAREAID    = S.DATAAREAID
     AND B.[PARTITION]   = S.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN [Item_V] E
    ON  S.ITEMID      = E.[Item ID]
    AND S.[PARTITION] = E.[PARTITION]
    AND S.DATAAREAID  = E.Company
    WHERE S.DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
    GROUP BY
        S.ITEMID, 
        D.INVENTLOCATIONID, D.WMSLOCATIONID, D.INVENTBATCHID,
        B.EXPDATE, B.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE, E.[Item Name]
),
WHS_location AS (
    SELECT
        WMSLOCATIONID,
        INVENTLOCATIONID,
        DATAAREAID
    FROM dbo.WMSLOCATION_V
    WHERE DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
)
SELECT
    A.ITEMID,
    A.INVENTLOCATIONID,
    A.INVENTBATCHID,
    A.PHYSICALINVENTORY,
    A.AVAILABLEPHYSICAL,
    A.RESERVPHYSICAL,
    A.ONORDER,
    A.ORDERED,
    A.EXPDATE,
    A.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE,
    A.[Item Name],
    CASE
      WHEN A.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE IS NULL THEN 'YES'
      WHEN A.EXPDATE IS NULL THEN 'YES'
      WHEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) < DATEADD(MONTH, -8, A.EXPDATE) THEN 'YES'
      ELSE 'NO'
    END AS Usable
FROM Inv_location A
LEFT JOIN WHS_location W
  ON A.WMSLOCATIONID    = W.WMSLOCATIONID
 AND A.INVENTLOCATIONID = W.INVENTLOCATIONID
 AND W.DATAAREAID       = 'rdsi'
description: CTE-based query identifying inventory expiring within 30 days by location, warehouse, and batch with usability flag.
